description: fixed 800w/100w chunking, all-MiniLM-L6-v2 dense-only, top-k cosine

encoder_truncation.note: all-MiniLM-L6-v2 accepts 256 word-pieces. Dense regulatory English exceeds that well before 800 words, so the tail of every chunk is truncated before embedding. recall_ceiling is the highest Recall any top-k over this index could reach: the remaining clauses were never encoded, so no value of k can retrieve them.
